preconditions.description: The number of columns n is between 1 and 100,000.
There are exactly 2n - 1 edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 2*n and 1 <= bi <= 2*n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range [1, 2n].

postconditions.description: The number of ways to place the tree on the table is non-negative.
The number of ways is less than 1,000,000,007.
The output is the number of valid ways to place the tree on the table modulo 1,000,000,007.
